title: OpenAI autolog streaming: a stream that yields zero chunks must end the span with outputs=None instead of raising UnboundLocalError
answers: Streaming chat completion with mlflow.openai.autolog() on raises UnboundLocalError when the server sends no chunks
Why does my OpenAI stream loop fail at the end with autolog enabled even though the API call succeeded?
Where is the OpenAI autolog stream output logging hook handled for sync and async clients?
What trace output does autolog record for a streaming response that is empty?
body:
Path: mlflow/openai/autolog.py:_stream_output_logging_hook (sync and async variants) wraps the iterator returned for stream=True calls under autolog, adds one chunk event per chunk, collects output, and logs the final outputs when the stream ends.
Rule: Any loop variable read after the for/async for in these hooks (here `chunk`, used by _process_last_chunk) must be initialized to None before the loop. An empty stream then ends the span normally with outputs=None, rather than raising UnboundLocalError. The fix pattern is `chunk = None` before the loop in both sync and async hooks.
Symptom: With autolog on, a streaming chat completion whose server sends only `data: [DONE]` (no chunks) made the user's iteration loop fail with UnboundLocalError: chunk when the stream ended, even though the API call itself succeeded.
Constraints: Applies only when the stream yields zero chunks; non-empty streams behave as before. Covered by tests/openai/test_openai_autolog.py:test_chat_completions_streaming_no_chunks (sync and async), which uses the EMPTY_STREAM case in tests/openai/mock_openai.py:chat and asserts the trace status is OK with span outputs None.
applies: OpenAI autolog streaming output logging for chat completions (and other stream=True hooks) when the stream produces no chunks.
says: Streaming chat requests crash at completion when the model returns an empty response.
Automatic tracing causes streaming loops to fail when the server sends no chunks.
Blank streaming chat completions should complete cleanly without throwing errors during iteration.
Empty streaming responses should record a completed trace span with no output.
search: In OpenAI autolog streaming output logging hooks (mlflow/openai/autolog.py:_stream_output_logging_hook), loop variables like chunk read after the loop must be initialized to None before the loop so empty streams end the span with outputs=None instead of raising UnboundLocalError. This applies to sync and async stream logging hooks for chat completions when the stream yields zero chunks, while non-empty streams remain unchanged. The behavior is covered in tests/openai/test_openai_autolog.py:test_chat_completions_streaming_no_chunks using tests/openai/mock_openai.py:chat with the EMPTY_STREAM case.
